event.title: Boyos Wonderland x INI Movement Present: Summer Jam
event.description: A full Summer Jam day at Houtbaar Haarlem where Boyos Wonderland and INI Movement bring open jams, DJs, live musicians, records, tattoos and an inside afterparty together from 13:00 to 02:00.

startNotice.title: Summer Jam starts at 13:00
startNotice.body: Some tickets and event listings still show the old start time. AEV.AYA opens at 13:00 and the first Open Jam begins at 14:00, so the day is moving from the moment the garden opens.

schedule.title: From garden to inside
schedule.openJamNote: The Open Jam has no fixed roster. Artists who joined through an INI Movement jam ticket can step in, with SYNGA keeping the session moving and making space for the music to find its own direction.

press.title: Summer Jam in 3voor12 Noord-Holland
press.summary: 3voor12 Noord-Holland spoke with Shamis about how Summer Jam brings live improvisation, club culture and Haarlem's music community together.

finalCta.title: Meet us where the garden turns into a dancefloor.
finalCta.body: Advance tickets are €20. Late tickets and tickets at the door are €25. Arrive from 13:00, take the garden with you and follow the music inside when the evening turns.

concept: Summer Jam is where Boyos Wonderland and INI Movement meet at Houtbaar: a full day in the garden built around DJs, live musicians and people coming together for the same reason—to move.

The Open Jam is part of the day from the start. Artists joining through INI Movement can step in while SYNGA keeps the session moving. Later, Estafête lets DJs and musicians react to one another in real time, passing tracks between decks and live instrumentation.
Around it all, Team de Boef opens the tattoo pop-up, Ephemeris Records fills the garden with crates and Houtbaar keeps food and drinks moving.
When the garden closes at 23:00, the night moves inside and carries on until 02:00.

dayArc.name: The garden opens
dayArc.description: AEV.AYA starts behind the decks before the first Open Jam begins at 14:00.

dayArc.name: Open Jam
dayArc.description: Participating artists step in through the afternoon, with SYNGA guiding the session and leaving room for the music to change.

dayArc.name: Inside afterparty
dayArc.description: The garden closes and the room moves inside with UMOJA and Boyos Soundsystem until 02:00.

partners.name: Boyos Wonderland
partners.description: The event world around Boyos Collective: music, food, art, tattoos, and a dancefloor with room for everyone.

partners.name: INI Movement
partners.description: A creative movement bringing live music, open participation and the Estafête format into the day.

partners.name: Houtbaar
partners.description: The Haarlem home base for the garden programme and the inside continuation after 23:00.

partners.name: Powered by Oshi
partners.description: Oshi helps power the community energy around the day, connecting the music, movement and people around Summer Jam.

lineupGroups.title: Carrying the day
lineupGroups.intro: From the first record in the garden to the final stretch inside, these are the people guiding the movement of Summer Jam.

lineupGroups.title: Inside Estafête
lineupGroups.intro: A band built to respond in the moment: a rhythm section at the core, horns and guitar around it, SYNGA on vocals and DJs passing tracks into live hands.

lineupGroups.title: Crates and ink
lineupGroups.intro: The garden has more to find between sets, with records to dig through and a tattoo studio running throughout the day.

lineup.name: AEV.AYA
lineup.description: AEV.AYA is SYNGA behind the decks. Her sets are rooted in R&B, soul, funk and hip-hop: deep grooves, familiar vocals and newer cuts with enough bite to keep the floor moving. She opens Summer Jam before returning to the microphone later in the day.
lineup.alt: Summer Jam artist card for AEV.AYA

lineup.name: SYNGA
lineup.description: SYNGA is a singer, songwriter and MC moving through soul, hip-hop, Chicago house and alternative R&B. She hosts Summer Jam, keeps the Open Jams moving and sings inside Estafête, catching openings in the music and bringing the room into them.
lineup.alt: Summer Jam artist card for SYNGA

lineup.name: Boyos Soundsystem
lineup.description: Boyos Soundsystem is Mick, Tomas and Nico: three friends with disco and house at the core, joined by soca, zouk, Brazilian boogie and whatever earns its place in the set. They play through the afternoon and return after midnight for the final stretch inside.
lineup.alt: Summer Jam artist card for Boyos Soundsystem

lineup.name: Shamis
lineup.description: Shamis is a producer, DJ, songwriter, vocalist and founder of INI Movement. His path runs through hip-hop, soul, jazz, broken beat, house, reggae and afrobeat. He plays his own set first, then steps into Estafête to pass records, cues and live ideas back and forth with the band.
lineup.alt: Summer Jam artist card for Shamis

lineup.name: Tommaso
lineup.description: Tommaso is a Florence-born, Chicago-based selector, record digger and co-founder of Elevator Music Live. House music runs through his story, alongside global records and deep dancefloor history. At Summer Jam he plays his own vinyl set before going back and forth with the live musicians inside Estafête.
lineup.alt: Summer Jam artist card for Tommaso

lineup.name: UMOJA
lineup.description: Haarlem duo UMOJA have been digging through Afrobeat, cumbia, highlife, Benga, funk and electronic music since 2011. Their archival knowledge grew into original collaborations across Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania, connecting East African rhythms, Afro disco, basslines, guitar and percussion without taking the safe route.
lineup.alt: Summer Jam artist card for UMOJA

lineup.name: Estafête
lineup.description: Estafête brings DJs and musicians into the same moving conversation. Tracks are picked up, answered and rebuilt by the band in real time, leaving space for instinct, risk and the moments nobody could plan before the first record changes hands.
lineup.alt: Summer Jam formation card for Estafête

lineup.name: .Multibeat
lineup.description: At the centre of Estafête is .Multibeat: Boudewijn Pleij on keys, Thijs van Zutphen on bass and Aron Smit on drums. The future jazz trio brings hip-hop swing, jazz harmony and a collaborative instinct—the backbone that keeps everything moving while leaving room for the music around them to change.

lineup.name: Yasper
lineup.description: Yasper is an Amsterdam-based guitarist, producer, composer and musical director known for warm guitar-led beats across chillhop, lo-fi and downtempo. Inside Estafête, that detailed ear gets put to work in real time, responding to the band and the records as they move.
lineup.alt: Summer Jam artist card for Yasper

lineup.name: Rebiere
lineup.description: Rebiere is Lucas van Ee on saxophone and guitar. More than a decade of stages with Gallowstreet sits alongside years of building records, artists and live concepts behind the scenes. He knows the Estafête format and when to lead, answer or leave space.
lineup.alt: Summer Jam artist card for Rebiere

lineup.name: Lezaam Beets
lineup.description: Born and raised in Cape Town and now based in Amsterdam, trombonist Lezaam Beets carries South African jazz, West African rhythmic ideas and contemporary improvisation into the formation. His playing adds another voice for Estafête to follow and answer.
lineup.alt: Summer Jam artist card for Lezaam Beets

lineup.name: D!ma Loginov
lineup.description: Born in Kazakhstan and now based in Amsterdam, D!ma Loginov moves comfortably between jazz, funk, soul and pop. Work with Gallowstreet, Jungle by Night and his own projects all feed into a trumpet voice ready to react when Estafête changes direction.
lineup.alt: Summer Jam artist card for D!ma Loginov

lineup.name: Ephemeris Records
lineup.description: Ephemeris Records brings crates where Lollywood can sit next to Hollywood, tekno beside Turkish grooves and a shameless Eurodance record can suddenly make complete sense. Dig between sets, bring a tote and leave with something you did not know you needed.
lineup.alt: Summer Jam card for Ephemeris Records

lineup.name: Team de Boef
lineup.description: Ben de Boef, Mauro Mejia and Inktprikker host the Summer Jam tattoo studio with flash sheets, freehand options and styles moving from bold old-school work to detailed blackwork and clean fine lines. Walk by, talk to the artists and come early if you want a spot.
lineup.alt: Summer Jam card for Team de Boef tattoo studio

seo.title: Summer Jam Haarlem | Boyos Wonderland x INI Movement
seo.description: Summer Jam is a full garden-to-afterparty festival day at Houtbaar, Haarlem on Saturday 25 July 2026, with DJs, Open Jams, Estafête live, records and tattoos from 13:00 to 02:00.
seo.ogTitle: Summer Jam Haarlem | Boyos Wonderland x INI Movement

page.lineupIntro: The full programme moves between DJ sets, an open musical floor and Estafête's live response. These cards show the people carrying the day and the extras waiting around the garden.

practicalInfo.label: Time
practicalInfo.detail: Garden until 23:00, then the programme moves inside.

practicalSections.title: Tickets and entry
practicalSections.body: Advance tickets are €20. Late tickets and tickets at the door are €25.
items: Summer Jam is 18+. Bring a valid ID.
There is no re-entry after you leave the event.

practicalSections.title: The inside afterparty
practicalSections.body: Your festival ticket includes the afterparty. There are no separate afterparty tickets.
items: People will gradually be let inside from 23:00.
Indoor capacity is limited, so access cannot be guaranteed once the room is full.

practicalSections.title: Getting there
practicalSections.body: Houtbaar is at Woudplein 2, 2031 CZ Haarlem. Haarlem Spaarnwoude is the nearest train and bus stop.
items: The train from Amsterdam Centraal takes around 15 minutes.
Plan your journey home before you come.

practicalSections.title: Tattoos, records, food and drinks
practicalSections.body: Team de Boef works first come, first served. Ephemeris Records keeps the crates open through the day, while Houtbaar serves food and drinks.
items: Team de Boef prefers cash, but card is possible.
Ephemeris Records accepts cash and card.

practicalSections.title: Respect the groove
practicalSections.body: Everyone should feel safe and free to move. Respect boundaries and remember that consent matters.
items: No racism, sexism, queerphobia or harassment.
If something feels off, find the Boyos, INI or Houtbaar crew.

practicalSections.title: Camera notice
practicalSections.body: Professional photographers and videographers will be capturing Summer Jam throughout the day and night.
items: Tell the camera team or crew if you prefer not to appear in a recognizable close-up.
Wider crowd shots may still include you.

practicalSections.title: Bring with you
practicalSections.body: A few things will make the full garden-to-inside day easier.
items: Your festival ticket and valid ID.
Sunscreen, sunglasses, earplugs and a layer for later.
A tote for records and some cash for tattoos.
